description:
File: `scripts/batch_integration.py`, the `BatchError` raised in `_check_member_writes`. Its text says 'run each member in its own session with its own tractable identity', which contradicts the rule that a member may be a subagent of its leader.

Change. Reword that one message: members never write to the tracker; inspect each listed write with `show_item`; land again with `ACCEPT_WRITES=<op_id,...>` to record reviewed writes. No identity instruction.

Decision gates.
- If a test asserts the old wording, update the assertion to the behaviour it protects (a refusal that names the op ids), not to the new sentence.
- If any behavioural test in `tests/unit/scripts/test_batch_integration.py` fails after the edit, stop: the edit touched logic and must be redone.
- Changelog: add a fragment only if `make changelog-check` or `make pr-preflight` asks for one; `scripts/` is not a shipped path.

Guardrails. One string literal changes. `LEADER_MEMBER_OPS`, `member_tracker_writes`, the window bounds, the accepted-write handling and every other refusal stay byte-identical. No new comment or docstring (comment policy). The umbrella's guardrails also apply.
